scenarios.title: Accordion
scenarios.description: One section open at a time. Opening another closes it; the open one closes on a click.
scenarios.source:
<sl:accordion name="accordion-demo">
  <sl:accordion-item open>
    <sl:accordion-trigger>Is it accessible?</sl:accordion-trigger>
    <sl:accordion-content>Yes. Each section is a details element, which the browser opens and closes, from the
      keyboard too.</sl:accordion-content>
  </sl:accordion-item>
  <sl:accordion-item>
    <sl:accordion-trigger>Is it styled?</sl:accordion-trigger>
    <sl:accordion-content>Yes. It comes with default styles that match the other components.</sl:accordion-content>
  </sl:accordion-item>
  <sl:accordion-item>
    <sl:accordion-trigger>Is it animated?</sl:accordion-trigger>
    <sl:accordion-content>Yes, where the browser can animate a height to auto, and only when the user has not
      asked for reduced motion.</sl:accordion-content>
  </sl:accordion-item>
</sl:accordion>
scenarios.html:

scenarios.title: Dialog
scenarios.description: A form in a dialog. The form wraps the dialog, so the submit button in its footer submits it.
scenarios.source:
<sl:button variant="outline" commandfor="edit-profile" command="show-modal">Edit profile</sl:button>
<form method="post" action="/profile">
  <sl:dialog id="edit-profile">
    <sl:dialog-header>
      <sl:dialog-title>Edit profile</sl:dialog-title>
      <sl:dialog-description>
        Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you're done.
      </sl:dialog-description>
    </sl:dialog-header>
    <sl:field-group>
      <sl:field for="profile-name">
        <sl:field-label>Name</sl:field-label>
        <sl:input name="name" value="Pedro Duarte"/>
      </sl:field>
      <sl:field for="profile-username">
        <sl:field-label>Username</sl:field-label>
        <sl:input name="username" value="@peduarte"/>
      </sl:field>
    </sl:field-group>
    <sl:dialog-footer>
      <sl:button variant="outline" commandfor="edit-profile" command="close">Cancel</sl:button>
      <sl:button type="submit">Save changes</sl:button>
    </sl:dialog-footer>
  </sl:dialog>
</form>
